# Better Than Awesome

Better Than Awesome is a robotics discovery, editorial, affiliate and market-intelligence site.

Primary site: https://betterthanawesome.com/

## Machine-readable endpoints
- Robot catalog: https://betterthanawesome.com/api/catalog.json
- Robot categories: https://betterthanawesome.com/api/categories.json
- Procurement dataset: https://betterthanawesome.com/api/procurement.json
- OpenAPI contract: https://betterthanawesome.com/openapi.yaml
- XML sitemap: https://betterthanawesome.com/sitemap.xml

## Human-facing destinations
- Robot catalog: https://betterthanawesome.com/robots/
- Robot categories: https://betterthanawesome.com/categories/
- Robot Pulse: https://betterthanawesome.com/pulse/
- Robot Signal: https://betterthanawesome.com/signal/
- Agent documentation: https://betterthanawesome.com/agents/

## Data principles
- Product records include verification dates when available.
- Unknown values are omitted rather than invented.
- Seller and affiliate links are identified separately from editorial content.
- Pricing and availability can change and should be confirmed with the seller.

## Agent procurement
Use https://betterthanawesome.com/api/procurement.json when selecting robots for a purchasing or evaluation task. Records expose known fields, missing-data warnings, verification dates, regional marketplaces, and attributed human handoff URLs.
